name: harvest-input
description: Holding E reaches the sim's harvest intent. Harvest rules themselves are unit tested.

steps.comment: Map cell (8, 7) spans z 28..32; the player stands 1 unit past its edge.
45 frames at --fixed-fps 30 is 1.5 s, half of Wood's 3 s gather time.
One Wood once 3 s (90 frames) have passed.
One Wood is not the Lumber Camp's whole cost of 15.
